xmldoc.short_description: Return the handle of the current block.

param_output_item.param_description: a numeric handle for the current block, or the empty matrix [] when no block is selected.

description.p: gcbh returns a numeric handle for the current block, the block selected in the editor (the same block gcb reports as a path).
The handle is a reference-style value that can be passed to get_param and set_param in place of the block path. It stays valid until the block is deleted or its model is closed.
gcbh returns the empty matrix [] when no block is selected or no editor is active, mirroring gcb, which returns the empty string in that case.
